Yes, absolutely — it should stay put. If a page is just having a bad day and won't load, deleting my bookmark would be the worst possible reaction; it'd be gone by the time the site came back. And even if a page vanishes for good, my title, my labels, and especially my note still have value to me — they're a record of what I found and why I cared, and sometimes that's enough to go track down the thing elsewhere.

So nothing should ever be removed from my library on its own. The only thing that should make a bookmark leave is *me* choosing to delete it. If a page won't open, by all means let me know it's not loading, but keep my saved copy safe until I say otherwise.
